mission.mission_purpose: Today's Mission exists to protect memory of Campaign Gamma and the Beta distributional entry — retrieving family placement, probability/quantile evaluation, Poisson process connection, inverse transform, and software generation — so 2.1 does not evaporate before joint distributions.

mission.educational_intent: Produce retrieval strength on the Campaign Educational Objective: evaluate → process link → generate (method + software), with continuity to Beta family placement.

mission.concept_focus: Campaign chain retrieval: place → evaluate → process → inverse → software.
mission.prior_bridge: Yesterday you finished software generation (2.1.6). Today is Revision mode: return to 2.1.1–2.1.6 skills under closed-book retrieval — no new first-pass LO.
mission.why_now: Pilot Arc law requires Revision after the Learning span; spacing protects Continuity Front closure before successor 2.2 work.
mission.expected_benefit: Evidence that 2.1 chain retrieves — revision Study Progress, not a claim that Chapter 2 or exam journey is complete.
mission.explainability: Assigned as Campaign Gamma Revision because Architecture requires memory return inside the Pilot Arc before the next Volume.
